entities.name: Vimaladharmasuriya I of Kandy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wimaladharmasūriya I was the king of the Kingdom of Kandy from 1592 to 1604. He is best known for successfully repelling two major Portuguese offensives: the Battle of Danture in 1594 and the Battle of Balana in 1602, in both of which the Portuguese suffered decisive defeats.
